Optional: put local copies of third-party libs here to work fully offline.

    marked.min.js   https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked/marked.min.js
    purify.min.js   https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dompurify@3/dist/purify.min.js

Then change the script tags in index.html to /vendor/marked.min.js
and /vendor/purify.min.js.
